notes: Discovery only. Do not import, publish, archive, or add these to an Amazon wishlist automatically.
Prices, ratings, and availability are captured from public listings at sourcing time. Null means the metric was not available.
Amazon candidates approved by a human should be added manually to 00 - Unclassified Gift Ideas, then exported through the existing wishlist pipeline.

candidates.title: SIGNOOGLE Best Dad Personalised Photo Tabletop Frame
candidates.why_interesting: A father-labelled keepsake rather than a generic men's accessory, in the under-₹500 band.
candidates.father_specific_reason: This is a Best Dad photo display a child would give a father, not a generic object a man could use.

candidates.title: Incredible Gifts India Personalised Engraved Wooden Father's Day Photo Frame
features: Photo and message engraved on wood
Positioned as a Father's Day gift from son or daughter
candidates.why_interesting: Explicit paternal engraving, but live price and rating were not captured.
candidates.father_specific_reason: The product is sold as a Father's Day engraved photo for dad, not as unisex home decor.

candidates.title: Incredible Gifts India Customised Diary for Dad
features: World's Best Papa / Best Dad Ever variants
candidates.why_interesting: A usable notebook that is dad-labelled rather than a generic diary.

candidates.title: Sytara Personalized Star Map

candidates.title: KODAK 11.6-Inch WiFi Digital Photo Frame

candidates.title: FNP Sacred Serenity Spa Experience
candidates.why_interesting: A genuine spa session at participating hotel wellness centres, not a physical hamper.
candidates.location_restrictions: Participating Taj, Vivanta, Radisson, Marriott, Accor, and ITC spa facilities; subject to property selection and availability.
candidates.validity: Advance appointment required; cancellations at least 24 hours before the appointment.
candidates.redemption_method: Purchase on fnp.com, then book a 30-minute Vishudhi therapy session for one person at a participating spa.
candidates.affiliate_viability: FNP is a configured merchant but affiliate_enabled and search_enabled are false. Not Amazon-wishlist intake.
candidates.recipient_suitability: Adults who want a wellness outing; good for Mother, partner, or self-care gifting.
